dogecoin.text: Dogecoin's entire market is controlled by 100 people only. Over 68% of Dogecoin's are distributed among 98nwallets across the world, while a single wallet holds 28% of all Dogecoin.
Just 5 wallets control 40% of Doge's supply. If they dump all coins and cash out, then it will take few seconds for Dogecoin to crash.
